name: SikaCeram-880 Easy Epoxy
paste:
SIKACERAM®-880 EASY EPOXY: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy, December 2025, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/sikaceram-880-easyepoxy.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy is a two-part, easy to use, coloured epoxy-based tile grout and adhesive. It is suitable for floor and wall application.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy is used for bonding and grouting of the following types of tiles:
    - Ceramic and porcelain tiles
    - Glass mosaic
    - Seawater pools
    - Swimming pools
    - Thermal pools
    - Turkish baths
    - Private and public bathrooms
    - Commercial, industrial, or residential kitchens
    - Dairies
    - Tanneries
    - Paper mills
    - Laboratories
    - Slaughterhouses
    SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy is used for bonding and grouting tiles for the following applications:
    SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy is used for interior and exterior applications.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Please note.
    - The Product may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Do not use for any other applications that are not explicitly described in this Product Data Sheet.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Easy to use epoxy tile grout and adhesive.
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Sustainability.
    - VOC emission classification GEV Emicode EC1plus
2.3 Certificates and test reports.
    - CE marking and declaration of performance based on EN 12004:2007+A1:2012 Adhesives for tiles — Reactive resin adhesives — All internal and external tiling
2.4 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 12004:2007+A1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - AS ISO 13007: cited with a stated property or value; test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Product declaration (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile adhesion strength (p.2).
    - EN 12808-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Abrasion resistance (p.2).
    - EN 12808-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2); Technical Information > Flexural-strength (p.2).
    - EN 12808-4: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shrinkage (p.2).
    - EN 12004-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Skid / slip resistance (p.2).
    - EN 12808-5: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Water absorption (p.2).
2.5 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Grout joint range: 1 to 20 mm
    - Very good resistance to specific chemicals
    - Good resistance to staining
    - Easy to clean
    - Highly thixotropic for tiling and grouting on floor and wall
    - Impermeable to water and water vapour
    - High abrasion resistance
    - Very good workability
    - Very good UV stability
2.6 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Epoxy resin, aggregates and special additives
    - Colour: White, Silver Grey, Grey, Anthracite, & Platinum Grey
    - Appearance: Part A: Viscous liquid, Part B: Coloured paste
2.7 Product declaration.
    | Adhesive for ceramic | Class: R2 T | AS ISO 13007 |
    | tiles |
    | Grout for tiles | Class: RG | AS ISO 13007 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.8 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Abrasion resistance: ≤ 250 mm ³ (EN 12808-2)
    - Compressive strength: ≥ 45 MPa (EN 12808-3)
    - Flexural-strength: ≥ 30 MPa (EN 12808-3)
    - Shrinkage: ≤ 1.5 mm/m (EN 12808-4)
    - Chemical resistance: Resistant to many chemicals. Contact Sika Technical Services for additional information.
    - Skid / slip resistance: ≤ 0.5 mm (EN 12004-2)
    - Water absorption: After 240 mm - ≤ 0.1 g (EN 12808-5)
2.9 Tensile adhesion strength.
    | Initial | ≥ 2 MPa |
    | Water immersion | ≥ 2 MPa |
    | Thermal shock | ≥ 2 MPa |
    Test method printed: AS ISO 13007
2.10 Temperature resistance.
    | Maximum | +80 °C |
    | Minimum | -20 °C |
2.11 Joint width.
    | Maximum | 20 mm |
    | Minimum | 1 mm |
2.12 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 5 kg containers (Part A+B)
    - Shelf life: 24 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 0 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to the packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 02.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Open Time: 60 minutes
4.3 Mixing ratio.
    | Part A+B | 4.01 kg base component + 0.99 kg |
    | hardener component |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Consumption. Approximately 1.6 kg/m² and mm layer thickness; TILE LAYING
    | Notch size | Consumption |
    | 4 mm | 1.9 kg/m² |
    | 6 mm | 2.3 kg/m² |
    | 8 mm | 3.2 kg/m² |
    | 10 mm | 3.8 kg/m² |
    | GROUTING |
    | Notch size | Consumption |
    | Medium mosaic 5 × 5 cm | 1.0 kg/m² |
    | (3 mm joint width, 5 mm joint depth) |
    | Tiles 20 × 20 cm | 0.7 kg/m² |
    | (5 mm joint width, 8 mm joint depth) |
    | Fully vitrified tiles 30 × 60 cm | 0.3 kg/m² |
    | (4 mm joint width, 8 mm joint depth) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.5 Layer thickness.
    | Minimum adhesive bed thickness | 1 mm |
4.6 Pot Life.
    | At +20 °C | 45 min |
4.7 Curing time. TILING
    | Waiting time before grouting on the | 4 hours |
    | wall |
    | Waiting time before grouting on the | 16 hours |
    | floor |
    | GROUTED FLOOR COVERING |
    | Walkable after | 16 hours |
    | Can be exposed to water or chemic- | 3 to 7 days |
    | als after |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.8 Waiting time.
    | Emulsifiable/rewashable | 10–60 minutes |
4.9 Mixing equipment.
    - Electric single-paddle mixer (up to 300 rpm) with spiral paddle
4.10 Application equipment.
    - Notched trowel
    - Trowel
    - Rubber float
    - Sponge float
    - Soft cloth
    - Grout finishing tool
4.11 Tiling. Suitable substrates include the following materials:
    - Cementitious materials
    - Gypsum and cement-based substrates
    - Paint coating
    - Tiles
    - Metal
    - Glass fibre-reinforced plastic
    For other substrate types, contact Sika Technical Services.
4.12 Important. Carry out equipment trials; Carry out equipment trials to make sure the Product can be mixed satisfactorily before full project application. The following conditions regarding substrate quality must be fulfilled or appropriate measures must be taken.
    - Cementitious substrates must be sufficiently cured and dried (between 2 to 6 weeks).
    - All substrates must possess structural stability to bear the weight of the new tiling while providing a secure and firm base.
    - Surfaces must be dry and clean, free of loose or friable particles and contaminants such as dust, dirt, oil, wax polish, grease, cement laitance, or efflorescence.
    - Prepare substrates mechanically using techniques such as sanding and scraping to remove all traces of any materials that could reduce the product’s adhesion to the substrate. Remove all dust, loose and friable material from the application surface with industrial vacuuming equipment.
    - Smooth surfaces must be roughened lightly to improve adhesion.
    - When laying tiles on non-absorbent or substrates with limited absorbency, such as existing tiles or painted surfaces, ensure these surfaces are stable, firmly bonded, and securely in place. Afterwards, use suitable degreasing or descaling products to clean the surface thoroughly and completely.
    - For tiling in constantly damp or wet rooms, a suitable Sika® waterproofing product or system must be applied to the substrate before tiling.
4.13 Grouting.
    - All surfaces must be clean, dry and free of grease.
    - Ensure the joint does not contain excess tile adhesive.
4.14 Mixing. SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy is a reactive product. It sets from a chemical reaction between the two parts, A and B. These parts must be thoroughly mixed at the correct mixing ratio. Mix full units only. 1. Mix part A (the resin component) briefly using an electric single paddle mixer with a spiral paddle. 2. Add part B (hardener) to part A and mix both parts continuously for 3 minutes until the mixture achieves a uniform colour. 3. Transfer mixed material to a clean bucket and mix again thoroughly.
4.15 Important. Risk of cracking due to application in direct sun or strong winds
    - Do not apply the Product in hot direct sun, strong winds or both.
4.16 Important. Absorbency of natural stone; Staining from plasticiser migration may occur when used on natural stone.
    - Conduct a test prior to application
4.17 Tile grouting.
    - SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy is applied using an appropriate rubber float.
    - Preconditions
    - Observe the tile adhesive curing time before starting to grout. 1. Completely fill the joints and compact them uniformly. 2. Using the same float, remove excess grout from the tile surfaces, moving the tool diagonally across the joints.
4.18 Important.
    - Leaving the surface too long before cleaning
    - Epoxy haze caused during application will be difficult to safely remove if the SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy is left too long before cleaning. 1. At +20 °C the initial, emulsifying clean can be given 10–45 minutes after finishing the grouting. 2. At +20 °C, the surface can be given a second clean, using more water, up to 60 minutes after mixing the Product. 3. Higher ambient temperatures will reduce this period and lower ambient temperatures will extend it.
    - Preconditions
    - The grout has set sufficiently to avoid it being removed from the joint during cleaning. 1. For an initial, emulsifying clean, use a small amount of clean water and a sponge float. 2. Rub the tiles in a circular motion to remove excess material. Rinse the sponge frequently. 3. For the second clean, wash the surface with a sponge float in diagonal movements. Add SikaCeram-960 Epoxy Finish to the wash water, diluted 1 : 100. 4. IMPORTANT Rinse the sponge and change the wash water frequently. Remove any smears or remaining haze. 5. On the same day, check if the surface is clean as soon as it has dried. Repeat the cleaning process if necessary. 6. When the grout has cured the next day, use SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish diluted 1 : 100 in clean water to remove any remaining haze.
4.19 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature.
    | Maximum | +25 °C |
    | Minimum | +5 °C |
5.3 Substrate temperature.
    | Maximum | +25 °C |
    | Minimum | +10 °C |
5.4 Substrate moisture content.
    | Cementitious substrates | Calcium carbide meth- | ≤ 4 % |
    | od (CM-method) |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
5.5 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Conduct a test prior to application
5.6 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Abrasion resistance: ≤ 250 mm ³ (EN 12808-2)
    - Compressive strength: ≥ 45 MPa (EN 12808-3)
    - Flexural-strength: ≥ 30 MPa (EN 12808-3)
    - Shrinkage: ≤ 1.5 mm/m (EN 12808-4)
    - Tensile adhesion strength: Initial | ≥ 2 MPa; Water immersion | ≥ 2 MPa; Thermal shock | ≥ 2 MPa AS ISO 13007
    - Skid / slip resistance: ≤ 0.5 mm (EN 12004-2)
    - Water absorption: After 240 mm - ≤ 0.1 g (EN 12808-5)
5.7 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.8 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaCeram®-880 Easy Epoxy, December 2025, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/q/sikaceram-880-easyepoxy.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaCeram - 880 Easy Epoxy Part B.pdf, version 18/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/SDS%20SikaCeram%20-%20880%20Easy%20Epoxy%20Part%20B%20GHS7%20(1).pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaCeram - 880 Easy Epoxy Part A.pdf, version 18/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/SDS%20SikaCeram%20-%20880%20Easy%20Epoxy%20Part%20A%20GHS7%20(3).pdf
    - Brochure: SikaCeram 880 Easy Epoxy Product Flyer.pdf, version 19/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/SikaCeram%20880%20Easy%20Epoxy%20Product%20Flyer.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaCeram and SikaSeal Colour Partner Selection Card.pdf, version 19/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/SikaCeram%20and%20SikaSeal%20Colour%20Partner%20Selection%20Card.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
